item.text: The source lint passes with no findings. The sandbox blocks both the browser inspector’s local server and Chrome startup, so I’m checking the HTML structure and interaction logic directly; I can’t claim a visual browser review here.

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import re
s=Path('index.html').read_text()
class Audit(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.links=[]; self.headings=[]; self.count=Counter(); self.remote=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs); self.count[tag]+=1
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if tag=='a':self.links.append(a.get('href',''))
  if tag in ('img','image','video','source'):self.remote.append(a)
  if tag=='input':assert a.get('type')=='email' and 'required' in a
p=Audit();p.feed(s)
assert len(p.ids)==len(set(p.ids)), 'Duplicate IDs'
assert all(x[1:] in p.ids for x in p.links if x.startswith('#') and x"'!='"'#'), 'Broken anchor'
assert p.count['h1']==1
assert p.count['details']==5 and p.count['summary']==5
assert not p.remote, 'Unexpected external imagery'
assert s.count('data-shift=')==3
assert s.count('data-billing=')==2
assert s.count('data-plan=')==3
assert s.count('class=\"feature\"')==6
assert s.count('class=\"footer-column\"')==4
for text in [\"Know who's on call.\",\"Hand off without losing the thread.\",\"Northgate Labs\",\"Plinth\",\"Corvid Systems\",\"Halden Bank\",\"Murmur\",\"Rotation builder\",\"Swaps and overrides\",\"Escalation policies\",\"Handoff notes\",\"Calendar sync\",\"Fairness report\",\"Dana Whitfield\",\"Ravi Menon\",\"Sofia Brandt\",\"99.95% uptime SLA\",\"© 2026 Rotaline, Inc.\"]:
 assert text in s, text
assert len(list(Path('.').glob('*')))==1
Path('/tmp/rotaline-taste/script.js').write_text(re.search(r'<script>([\\s\\S]*?)</script>',s).group(1))
print('PASS: document structure, unique IDs, section counts, all internal anchors, required content, inline imagery, email validation, and one-file output.')
